_comment: Shot list for episode 14, the fourth of six on sight lost and not given back. 18 new paintings plus the title and close backgrounds (prompts below, generated in this order in Gemini; Brian downloads them in order into images/ep14_the_voice_in_the_night/). Shared stills: the scroll, Brian's picture, the series picture (site_batch2/15), the lamp at Shiloh (episode 13's last picture), Henry's study (episode 7), the episode map (maps/ep14.png). Nobody's face is shown: people are seen from behind, far off, in silhouette, or as shapes against the light. Eli's fall is shown only as an empty chair on its back. Title and close cards get their lettering from make_cards.py (title_card.jpg, close_card.jpg).
style: Painterly oil-sketch look, visible brushwork, warm natural light, the land and buildings of ancient Israel in the time of the judges unless the prompt says otherwise. No faces shown close up: people are seen from behind or at a distance. No text or lettering anywhere. Calm and hopeful, never frightening or graphic. 16:9.
